segments.name: sale of cleaning systems and other equipment
segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures and sells cleaning systems and other equipment for industrial customers, mainly in Singapore and Malaysia.
segments.evidence: We manufacture a broad range of cleaning systems, including aqueous washing systems, plating and cleaning systems, train cleaning systems and other equipment for our customers.

segments.name: provision of centralized dishware washing and general cleaning services
segments.description: Provides centralized dishwashing and general cleaning services, mainly to food and beverage establishments in Singapore.
segments.evidence: We have also provided general cleaning services since 2015, mainly for food courts in Singapore.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for cleaning systems and other equipment it sells, and for centralized dishwashing and general cleaning services provided mainly to food and beverage establishments in Singapore.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Group is based in Singapore and is principally engaged in: (i) the sale of cleaning systems and other equipment; and (ii) the provision of centralized dishwashing and ancillary services.
